167. One must not think that forms generate others similar to themselves within matter; for generating is the property of bodies. Rather, it is the right and duty of the **form** to dispose the seminal matter for generation by moving its own organs harmoniously, and to enclose within it a ray of light, or a secret spark of life, like a treasure. It is also its duty to imprint its own specific character upon that **vivifying Spirit** <note>original: "Spiritui viuifico." The life-giving breath or energy that animates the seed.</note> hidden in the seed. During the work of generation, through a pulsating heat and at a fixed time, this spirit unfolds itself into a **Soul** <note>original: "Animam."</note>, whether vegetable or animal. Thus, that which had been a secret and formal spirit within the seed becomes the **Form** within the compound. In this way, what was hidden in the bosom of **Nature** becomes manifest, and

<summary>This page explains how the immortality of a species is maintained through reproduction and describes the role of the "form" in imprinting a spark of life and a specific character onto the seminal spirit.</summary>
<keywords>immortality of species, generation, seminal matter, vivifying spirit, soul, form, Nature, spark of life</keywords>
